description: List the industries you can filter on, with lead counts. Pass `search` (for example "roof") to also find the more specific categories such as "Roofing contractor". Use the exact names it returns in the industry and category filters. Free.

search.description: Find industries and more specific categories containing this text, e.g. "roof".
